_evidence: 0x530162 tests 'cmp byte [0x7aafd3],0' and, when that is 0, 'cmp byte [0x7ab020],0'; either nonzero ORs 0xc into the render-state word. 0x7ab020 is not in 0x530162's referenced-globals list (fuzz:i32 left it at its image value), so it is varied here: 0 (both outcomes of the second compare need [0x7aafd3]==0, which fuzz:i32 hits), 1, 0xff. A plain byte compare, every value valid.
